# Open Practice

> Free, independent, practical AI learning. Every lesson and tool is learn-by-doing: brief → make → check → improve → ship. No signup needed; learners can bring their own free AI key or use guided templates without AI. Original lessons are CC BY 4.0; code is MIT.

## Free tools
- [Chrome Extension Creator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/chrome-extension-creator/): Free Chrome extension creator: answer 4 questions, get a working Manifest V3 extension ZIP, load it in Chrome and learn what every file does.
- [Website Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/website-generator/): Free website generator: describe your business, download a clean HTML/CSS site and publish it free on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages.
- [Telegram Bot Creator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/telegram-bot-creator/): Free Telegram bot creator: define commands, download a secure webhook bot for Cloudflare Workers and deploy it on the free plan. Optional AI replies.
- [PWA Mobile App Creator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/pwa-app-creator/): Free PWA creator: generate an installable, offline-capable mobile web app (checklist, habit tracker or notes). No app store needed.
- [Google Sheets Script Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/google-sheets-script/): Free Google Sheets script generator: clean a column, highlight duplicates or build a summary with a custom menu — non-destructive and explained.
- [Landing Page Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/landing-page-generator/): Free landing page generator: headline, problem, benefits and one call to action in a single fast HTML file, checked for clarity and honest claims.
- [Discord Bot Creator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/discord-bot-creator/): Free Discord bot creator: define slash commands and deploy a signature-verified interactions bot on Cloudflare Workers — no always-on server.
- [AI Chatbot Widget Creator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/ai-chatbot-widget/): Free chatbot widget creator: an embeddable help bubble that answers from your FAQ — free with no AI, or AI-powered via your own secure Worker.
- [Zapier Automation Builder](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/zapier-automation/): Free automation builder workshop: design a Zapier, Make or n8n flow with trigger, filter, actions, field mapping, tests and a stop switch.
- [WordPress Plugin Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/wordpress-plugin-generator/): Free WordPress plugin generator: a notice shortcode, reading-time label or footer text — with the security basics every plugin needs.
- [Blog Post Writer](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/blog-post-writer/): Free blog post writer workshop: plan, draft and check a 600–1,200 word article with your own AI key or a guided template. No signup.
- [Email Writer](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/email-writer/): Free email writer workshop: write professional emails with one clear ask, the right tone and a subject line. Use your own AI key or a guided template.
- [Email Subject Line Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/email-subject-lines/): Free email subject line generator workshop: write and test 10 subject lines for length, clarity and spam triggers. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Cold Email Writer](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/cold-email-writer/): Free cold email writer workshop: write short, honest outreach with real personalisation, one ask and an easy opt-out. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Cover Letter Writer](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/cover-letter-writer/): Free cover letter writer workshop: match your evidence to a job ad, write 250–400 words and check for specifics. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Product Description Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/product-description/): Free product description generator workshop: turn features into benefits, add specs and check for honest claims. Own AI key or guided template.
- [FAQ Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/faq-generator/): Free FAQ generator workshop: collect real questions, write short accurate answers and check them for clarity. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Press Release Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/press-release/): Free press release generator workshop: news angle, the 5 Ws, a real quote and contact details — checked for structure. Own AI key or guided template.
- [YouTube Description Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/youtube-description/): Free YouTube description generator workshop: summary, timestamps, links and search phrases — checked for format. Own AI key or guided template.
- [YouTube Title Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/youtube-title-generator/): Free YouTube title generator workshop: 10 titles under 60 characters using proven angles, checked for honesty and length. Own AI key or guided template.
- [TikTok Script Writer](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/tiktok-script/): Free TikTok script writer workshop: hook, beats, on-screen text and call to action for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Viral Hook Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/viral-hook-generator/): Free hook generator workshop: write 10 opening lines for posts and videos using proven patterns, checked for length and honesty. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Social Media Bio Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/social-bio/): Free social media bio generator workshop: who you help, how, and proof — within each platform’s character limit. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Hashtag Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/hashtag-generator/): Free hashtag generator workshop: build a mix of broad, niche and local hashtags and check for count and relevance. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Business Name Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/business-name-generator/): Free business name generator workshop: generate names, then check length, pronunciation and availability steps. Own AI key or guided template.
- [SWOT Analysis Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/swot-analysis/): Free SWOT analysis generator workshop: evidence-based strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats plus actions. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Job Description Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/job-description-generator/): Free job description generator workshop: outcomes, must-haves vs nice-to-haves, pay and inclusive language checks. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Meeting Agenda Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/meeting-agenda/): Free meeting agenda generator workshop: purpose, timed items, owners and decisions needed — checked for timing. Own AI key or guided template.
- [Prompt Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/prompt-generator/): Free AI prompt generator workshop: turn a vague request into a structured, testable prompt. Use your own AI key or a guided template.
- [Image Prompt Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/image-prompt-generator/): Free image prompt generator workshop: subject, style, composition, lighting and exclusions for any AI image tool. Own AI key or guided template.
- [AI Workflow Builder](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/ai-workflow-builder/): Free AI workflow builder workshop: map a repetitive task into steps, choose where AI helps, and add human review and failure plans.
- [LinkedIn Bio Generator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/linkedin-bio/): Free LinkedIn bio generator workshop: headline under 220 characters and an About section with proof and a call to action. Own AI key or guided template.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/json-formatter/): Free JSON formatter and validator: pretty-print, minify and find the exact line of a JSON error — in your browser. Includes a fix-the-JSON challenge.
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/base64-encoder/): Free Base64 encoder and decoder that handles emoji and every language, with URL-safe mode. Runs in your browser. Includes a decoding challenge.
- [Markdown to HTML Converter](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/markdown-to-html/): Free Markdown to HTML converter with live preview: headings, lists, links, bold, code and quotes. Safe output, runs in your browser.
- [AI Token Counter](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/token-counter/): Free AI token counter: estimate tokens, words and context-window use for any prompt. Learn why shorter prompts cost less. Runs in your browser.
- [AI API Cost Calculator](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/free-tools/api-cost-calculator/): Free AI API cost calculator: requests, input and output tokens and price per million → monthly cost. Editable prices, runs in your browser.

## Courses
- [AI, without the guesswork](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/prompt.html): Write a reliable research brief
- [Your first business assistant](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/replies.html): Build a customer-reply prompt kit
- [Make messy data useful](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/sheets.html): Create a checked expense summary
- [From idea to working page](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/web.html): Publish a useful one-page tool
- [Automate the boring bit—safely](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/automation.html): Design an approval-first workflow
- [A cloud lab someone else can rerun](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/reproducible-cloud-lab.html): Ship a reproducibility bundle with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Direct an illustration with a measurable brief](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/visual-brief.html): Deliver an approved visual pack with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Build a prediction and an honest baseline](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/measured-ml.html): Ship a model card and test record with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Make a document assistant that knows when to stop](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/evidence-assistant.html): Hand off a bounded assistant with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Turn records into a tested Python report](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/python-records.html): Package a script another learner can inspect with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Test one AI claim in the real world](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/ai-fieldwork.html): Keep an evidence-based verdict with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Build a report that reconciles to its source](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/data-report.html): Deliver an auditable report pack with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Connect an AI API without trusting every response](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/api-integration.html): Ship an integration with a teardown note with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Classify feedback with an uncertainty bucket](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/text-classification.html): Ship an annotation and error guide with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Build a small project plan you can verify](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/project-planning.html): Deliver a plan and retrospective template with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Audit a tool with evidence, not an ethics slogan](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/responsible-ai.html): Deliver a reviewable risk record with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Join two datasets without multiplying the truth](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/data-wrangling.html): Deliver a wrangling pipeline with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Use a pipeline and a genuinely held-out set](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/sklearn-lab.html): Ship a versioned experiment bundle with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Find clusters—and show why they are not facts](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/clustering-lab.html): Ship a clustering exploration note with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.
- [Make Mula: useful work, honest offers](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/builds/make-mula.html): Decide from actual evidence with inputs, tests and a reproducible handoff.

## Facts
- Not accredited; self-review is not assessment.
- Keys entered in tools stay in the learner's browser and go straight to the chosen provider.
- Content last updated 2026-10-29.
